sources.query: SELECT session_id, time_created, type AS role, json_extract(data,'$.model.id') AS model, json_extract(data,'$.tokens.input') AS tin, json_extract(data,'$.tokens.output') AS tout, json_extract(data,'$.tokens.cache.read') AS tcr, json_extract(data,'$.tokens.cache.write') AS tcw FROM session_message WHERE type IN ('user','assistant') ORDER BY time_created
sources.fallbackQuery: SELECT session_id, time_created, json_extract(data,'$.role') AS role, json_extract(data,'$.modelID') AS model, json_extract(data,'$.tokens.input') AS tin, json_extract(data,'$.tokens.output') AS tout, json_extract(data,'$.tokens.cache.read') AS tcr, json_extract(data,'$.tokens.cache.write') AS tcw FROM message WHERE json_extract(data,'$.role') IN ('user','assistant') ORDER BY time_created
